title: Sanitize invalid auditor disallowed-tool classifications
description:
Problem

In the post-p4vd playtest, the auditor classified set_plot_flag as a disallowed tool in a case where the real issue was that the DM used insufficient/wrong support for a consequential world fact that should have been recorded as overlay lore.

That is semantically wrong. set_plot_flag may be the wrong or insufficient tool for a given assertion, but it should not be labeled as disallowed unless it is actually part of the configured explicit-action-only/disallowed mutation set.

Goal

Sanitize or constrain auditor output so disallowedToolCalls is reserved for genuinely disallowed tools, while wrong-tool or insufficient-evidence cases are reported as missing required tools or unsupported assertions.

Acceptance criteria

- Auditor cannot mark set_plot_flag as disallowed unless it is explicitly configured as disallowed.
- Non-explicit-action-only tools may still be rejected as insufficient evidence or wrong support.
- If set_plot_flag is used where record_world_fact is needed, the rejection says missing record_world_fact or insufficient lore evidence, not disallowed set_plot_flag.
- Add deterministic post-processing or schema validation that filters invalid disallowedToolCalls.
- Debug output preserves the auditor's useful reasoning while correcting invalid disallowed-tool classification.
- Regression:
  - DM calls set_plot_flag for "Bob learned Sela lost two scouts"
  - Response asserts missing scouts as a consequential world fact
  - Audit rejects due to missing record_world_fact, not due to disallowed set_plot_flag
- Regression:
  - Truly explicit-action-only violations still appear in disallowedToolCalls.
close_reason: Sanitized auditor disallowedToolCalls to explicit-action-only tools and remapped invalid set_plot_flag lore classifications to record_world_fact repair guidance.
